description: This file defines the LDAPService class responsible for LDAP communication within the OrangeHRM system, including connection management, querying, and authentication methods.

classes.name: LDAPService
classes.description: Service class providing LDAP connection, query, and authentication functionalities for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAP adapter instance, configured with system settings.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs LDAP bind operation using provided user credentials.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates an LDAP query object with specified distinguished name, query string, and options.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP search strings.
